title: Bimaar hai sughra
body:
AKBAR TERI AHMAD KI TALABGAAR HEY SUGRA BIMAAR HEY SUGRA X2
AAJA KE BHOT LAAWAR O LACHAAR HEY SUGRA BIMAAR HEY SUGRA
HONE NAHI DETI HEY MASAIB SE JO AZAAD BAS HEY WO TERI YAAD X2
BHAYI KI MOHABBAT MEI GIRAFTAAR HEY SUGRA BIMAAR HEY SUGRA
JAB SE GAYE BHAI MUJE LENE NAHI AAYEH MEI REGAYI HAIYE X2
DEHLEEZ PE BEHTI HEY AZADAAR HEY SUGRA BIMAAR HEY SUGRA
AB THAK TERE KADMO KE NISHAA CHUM RAHI HEY RAAHO MEI KHARI HEY
HUM RAAH TERE JAANEH KO TEYAAR HEY SUGHRA BIMAAR HEY SUGRA
PARDES MEI JAAKAR MUJE SAB BHOOL HI BEHTEH KHATH BHI NAHI LIKHKHE
KYA ISKA SABAB YEH HEY KE LAACHAAR HEY SUGRA BIMAAR HEY SUGHRA
MEI JAAN GAYI TUM NE RECHAALI WEHA SHAADI MERI NA KHABAR LI
KUMSIN HEY MAGAR BHAI SAMAJDAAR HEY SUGHRA BIMAAR HEY SUGHRA
KHATH CHOOM KE SARWAR NE KEHA KONSI SHAADI EH LAADLI BETI
HAR SAMT YEHA FOJ E SITAMGAAR HEY SUGHRA BIMAAR HEY SUGHRA
KYA TUJO KHABAR CHALNI HEY AKBAR KA KALEJAA AB KON HEY DULAA
BHAI TERA SOW ZAKHM SE DOW CHAAR HEY SUGHRA BIMAAR HEY SUGHRA
INN AAKHERI SASSO MEI BHI BAS DHYAN HEY TERA YU NA KARO SHIKWAA
BHAI KO TERE TUJSE BHOT PYAAR HEY SUGHRA BIMAAR HEY SUGHRA
AKBAR KE JANAAZE KO MEI KIS TARHA OUTHAOU MEI KISSKO BULAAOU
KASIM HEY NA ABBAS E ALAMDAAR HEY SUGHRA BIMAAR HEY SUGHRA
KEHTEH TH HASAN LAASHA E AKBAR PE YEH SARWAR SAR APNA JUKA KAR
BABA TERA BEYAARO MADADGAAR HEY SUGHRA BIMAAR HEY SUGHRA
